sections.title: Best friends, *and board besties*

image.alt: Ashley and Casey in their kitchen with wine and a charcuterie board

body: We are best friends who found each other in adulthood, even though we grew up in the same small town. We couldn’t have more opposite personalities, and that’s what makes us click.
We share a passion for creating, planning, laughing and drinking wine. Both of us are boy moms, and every board we make is customized and special: no two are the same.
list: Real wooden trays and serving pieces for events

items.text: First time ordering and was very impressed with the quality and quantity of the Board! Made a beautiful anniversary surprise!
Got a small bento box for a friend as a birthday present, it was PERFECT! Affordable, the perfect size, and arranged amazingly!
I’ve loved every board I’ve ordered for myself, get-togethers, and just for the kids! It’s so convenient to have them delivered right to your door.

items.q: How far ahead should I order?
items.a: We like a day’s notice but can sometimes do same day, so always call and ask. We’re closed on Sundays, but call and ask then too.
Curbside pickup is available to everyone. We deliver in Aiken for $15; outside Aiken, ask about the delivery charge.

items.q: Can I send a board as a gift?
items.a: Yes. Give us the address and we’ll take it to them, with a note if you like. Make sure they’ll be home, as we can’t leave food outside.
Tell us and we’ll leave it off. Our kitchen does use a variety of nuts, so we can’t guarantee there’s no cross-contamination.

items.q: How long can a board sit out?
items.a: The CDC recommends refrigerated food not sit out longer than two hours. For travel, bring a cooler and a few ice packs.
Yes: larger boards and grazing tables, priced by size, on real wooden trays with serving pieces that come back to us the next day.
